'''Kemix''' was a barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Kemix system/Legends|Kemix system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It had some minor [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] deposits located on it and [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] established a [[Spice Mines of Kemix|spice mine]] there to mine these. However, the mines were destroyed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
